item.title: Court filing: Charges filed in Anna Kepner’s cruise ship death

item.title: Savannah Guthrie and family offer $1 million reward for mother’s recovery
item.description: “Today” show host Savannah Guthrie said her family is now offering a $1 million reward for information leading to the recovery of her mother, Nancy Guthrie, who went missing from her Arizona home more than three weeks ago. Savannah Guthrie said Tuesday that her family is still holding out for a miracle and hopes her mother will... Read more »

item.title: Savannah Guthrie Offers $1M Reward for Mom Nancy Guthrie
item.description: Savannah Guthrie posts another video on social media pleading for her mother, Nancy Guthrie's return, offering a $1 million reward, noting she knows, 'She may be lost. She may already be gone.' (2/24/26)

item.title: Jury Sees Bodycam in Response to Richins’ Home
item.description: Bodycam video played for jurors reveals Kouri Richins’ reaction to her husband’s death after calling 911. Richins, still dressed in pajamas, recounts how she and her husband had a drink that night before going to bed to celebrate her closing on a $2 million house she flipped.

item.title: ‘Broke My Heart’ Murder Trial: Latoshia Daniels Speaks at Sentencing
item.description: Latoshia Daniels apologized to the courtroom before she was sentenced, saying, "Please know, I never meant for any of this to happen." Daniels was convicted of murdering Pastor Brodes Perry and shooting Perry's wife, Tabatha Perry Archie. (2/24/26)

item.title: EMT: Upon Arrival Eric Richins Was ‘Cold to the Touch… He Was Flatlined’
item.description: Advanced EMT, Margaret Offret details finding Eric Richins after responding to a 'drug overdose scene,' saying his body was 'cold to the touch... he was flatlined.' Kouri Richins is accused of poisoning Eric with a lethal dose of fentanyl. (2/24/26)

item.title: ‘I know what I did’: Latoshia Daniels offers apology at sentencing
item.description: MEMPHIS, Tenn. (Court TV) — Latoshia Daniels offered an emotional apology to the victims and their families, as well as her own family, as she was sentenced for killing her lover. item.title: ‘Broke My Heart’ Murder Trial: Latoshia Daniels Sentenced
item.description: Latoshia Daniels is sentenced after a jury convicted her of shooting and killing Pastor Brodes Perry and injuring Perry's wife, Tabatha Perry Archie. (2/24/26)
